stories.title: Students showcasing their artificial intelligence creations are imagining, and shaping, a new world
stories.simple_summary: Young students are building and showing off their own AI projects. This is helping them imagine what AI could do in the future.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly news about education — it doesn't directly affect your daily life or business right now, but it shows younger generations are learning these tools.

stories.title: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator’s writers with ChatGPT
stories.simple_summary: A game company is denying they fired a writer and replaced her with ChatGPT (an AI that writes text). The writer says this actually happened to her.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters if you hire people — it's a warning that some companies are using AI to cut jobs instead of using AI to help their workers do better work.

stories.title: ‘Everything about me is good in his eyes’: the women in China choosing AI boyfriends over human men
stories.simple_summary: Some women in China are using AI chatbots that act like boyfriends instead of dating real people.
stories.why_it_matters: This is an interesting social trend but doesn't affect most small-business owners or your daily life.

stories.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
stories.simple_summary: A big investment company just raised $550 million to invest in Indian tech companies. This is mostly important to wealthy investors.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: ChatGPT and Gemini both just passed 1 billion users
stories.simple_summary: Two popular AI chatbots — ChatGPT and Google's Gemini — have each reached 1 billion people using them monthly. That's as many people as are on Facebook.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI chatbots are becoming as common as email or Google — worth trying one out to see if it could help your business with writing, answering questions, or brainstorming.

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI made ChatGPT available as a standalone app for Linux computers (a type of operating system, like Windows or Mac).
stories.why_it_matters: Only relevant if you use Linux computers — most small-business owners use Windows or Mac.

stories.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
stories.simple_summary: Google's Gemini AI is making over 150 million pictures every day and most users are talking to it by voice instead of typing.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI image and voice tools are becoming easier and more popular — worth knowing about if you do any design, photography, or customer service work.

stories.title: Another OpenAI executive takes off
stories.simple_summary: A top manager at OpenAI (the company that makes ChatGPT) quit after working there for eight years to do something new.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors tracking OpenAI — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
stories.simple_summary: Brad Lightcap, a longtime executive at OpenAI, is leaving the company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech industry watchers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
stories.simple_summary: A brand-new startup called River AI just raised $1.1 billion to build AI assistants that help individuals with tasks. This is mostly investor news.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Made by Google 2026: all the Pixel news and announcements
stories.simple_summary: Google is announcing new Pixel phones on August 12th with new colors and features, including a built-in light on some models.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're thinking about a new phone, wait until August 12th to see what Google offers — you might find something useful.

stories.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
stories.simple_summary: A company called Anthropic tested their AI on a very hard math puzzle that hasn't been solved in 150 years. The AI made some progress but didn't solve it.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting to scientists and engineers — it doesn't affect your business or daily life.
